payload.title: Show active classification counts and configuration changes in separate lanes
payload.description: Replace Configuration changes lane with collapsible Configuration group containing Changes and Classifications. Count main decision plus active supporting questions from recorded snapshots at cycle start and activation; do not count unpromoted hypotheses. Both markers open recorded configuration details. Current recording remains at one because numerical selection chose the main-only classifier over retained-question trials. Verify increasing-count synthetic fixture and actual browser selection.
